title: 30A Beach Bungalow - 30A Five Star Properties
description_expanded:
🌴 30A BEACH BUNGALOW HIGHLIGHTS

⭐ Professionally managed with 24/7 guest support by 30A Five Star Properties for a smooth, worry-free vacation

🏖️ Only 800 steps to Eastern Lake Public Beach Access — easy beach days without the parking hassle

🛁 Brand-new hot tub for relaxing after sun-filled days

🐾 Pet-friendly home — bring up to 2 dogs (pet fee applies)

🚲 4 adult cruiser bikes included for exploring the neighborhood & scenic trails

⛱️ Beach gear provided — 4 chairs, 2 umbrellas & a wagon for effortless beach trips

🎶 Walk to dining & entertainment at Old Florida Fish House and grab your morning brew at Beachy Bean Coffee

☕ Spacious front porch perfect for slow mornings & relaxing evenings

🚿 Outdoor shower with hot water — rinse off after beach adventures

🔥 Gas grill ready for family cookouts

🌳 Private, tree-lined yard featuring a swing set, lounge area, outdoor dining & cornhole for family fun

🚗 Short drive to nearby hotspots — 5 minutes to Rosemary Beach and about 2 miles to Seaside

🥾 Close to nature at Deer Lake State Park — perfect for hiking, wildlife spotting & lake access

⚡ High-speed Wi-Fi & Smart TVs for streaming and staying connected

🍳 Fully stocked kitchen with bar seating & walk-in pantry for easy family meals

🧺 Laundry room conveniently located just off the kitchen

DETAILS: 30A Beach Bungalow is a 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom retreat offering 1,428 sq ft of coastal charm on the south side of 30A. Tucked down a private, tree-lined driveway in Seagrove, the home is ideally located near beach access, Eastern Lake, and the area's best dining. With its inviting front porch, large backyard, and thoughtfully designed interior, this home is perfect for a laid-back beach vacation with family or friends.

Inside, guests will find a comfortable living room with a Smart TV and no-fuss, streaming entertainment. The kitchen includes ample counter space, bar seating, and a walk-in pantry. The adjoining laundry room adds extra convenience. A queen bedroom and full bath are located on the main level, while upstairs hosts additional bedrooms that share a full bath. The outdoor space is a standout feature, offering a tranquil, shaded yard, cornhole, a dining area, a lounge zone, and a gas grill for easy al fresco meals. The home also comes with two complimentary bikes for exploring the 30A area.

SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: 4 Adults and 4 Kids max occupancy

FIRST FLOOR: -Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Full Bath

SECOND FLOOR: -Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Full Bath

Bunk Room: Two Twin Bunk Beds (Sleeps 4), Shared Full Bath

WE OFFER A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM GUEST AMENITIES Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath towels | Bed linens
